evidence.text: Pho bánh mì spring roll advertisement
Came back and tried the other popular dish, garlic noodles with lemongrass beef; while it’s good, I still prefer the Banh Mi. Service was great both times. …

Seriously love the banh mi here, tried a few, even the chicken and avocado one was amazing, the chicken was tender and perfectly seasoned. The drinks are also amazing including the egg viet coffee. The pho also is delicious

They start selling food at 11 AM!!! We came early and tried coffee, then got banh mi. It was huge and packed with filling. I tried the pork one and it was really good, but I couldn’t finish it. The place is clean and minimalistic, and the service is good and helpful.

Such a great local spot! The owners and staff are super friendly, and there’s plenty of seating both inside and outside. They have a wide variety of food options, from classic American breakfast and fresh pastries to banh mi, gluten-free …

Super cute cafe,  and delicious tofu bahn mi.
It was $11 (April 2026) and had lots of veggies and cilantro!
Try and grab one of the tables up by the big windows,  and then you can people watch as you eat
Chicken liver mousse and duck fat madeleines

evidence.text: Mi Lindo Peru. Peruvian restaurant. Bernal Heights. 3226 Mission St, San Francisco, CA 94110. $20–30

Delfina was absolutely divine! I had the Pappardelle & Duck Sugo 
(orange gremolata), and tried the Ricotta Cavatelli
 (lamb meatballs, dandelion greens) and literally did a little dance of joy when I tasted each. I could happily eat either …

Amazing food and beautiful presentation. The Miang Kum was my favorite such a unique combination of flavors. The beef in the Massaman curry was incredibly tender, and the duck salad was fresh and full of flavor. Everything tasted authentic and well-balanced. The mango sticky rice was the perfect ending (;
